_readme: Frame-relative SFX cues, resolved against real frame starts by scripts/wire-audio.mjs.
Every cue names its word. The kit is synthesised (tools/sfx.sh), so there is no licence
to record. Dramaturgy (DIRECTION.md): one porcelain clink that recurs and climbs
C5 → C6 → E6 → G6 and resolves as a C chord on the logo; nothing else repeats more than
twice. The -loud variants were made with scripts/level-sfx.mjs (see FINDINGS.md: its
silent-head check misfires on swells, whose peak is meant to come late).

02-served.word: Bontrivo — the O flies through the camera; the swell peaks at 0.5 as the iris completes
Restaurant-Website — the plate is set down
Fertig — sub under the first olive beat
Fertig — the garnish lands in the notch

05-vorbestellung.word: ab — the plate is carried off

06-branchen.word: Für … Catering — one texture under the whole truck, not a tick per plate

09-cta.word: Jetzt — the plate comes back down
bontrivo — the lockup lands: the clink resolves
